# Official MID-360 CAD

Source: https://www.livoxtech.com/mid-360/downloads
Download: https://terra-1-g.djicdn.com/65c028cd298f4669a7f0e40e50ba1131/Mid360/mid-360-asm.stp
Listed release date: 2023-01-10.

The STEP file is an unchanged download from Livox. Its hash is recorded in
sources.lock.json. Derived simulation meshes preserve its geometry and convert
millimetres to metres at URDF load time. Mesh colors are visualization choices.
This manufacturer's CAD is not covered by this integration's BSD license or by
the separate livox_laser_simulation repository's MIT license. No additional
redistribution license was included in the STEP download; retain its source
attribution when reusing it.
